purpose: The single typography stack + accessibility baseline that satisfies ALL 8 subnations + WCAG 2.2 AA + BDA Dyslexia Style Guide + JCQ Access Arrangements

typography_stack.primary: Arial, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Open Sans, Roboto, sans-serif
typography_stack.rationale: Arial is the only font confirmed to render Welsh ŵ/ŷ in every exam-board PDF (WJEC, CCEA, SQA). It is also on the BDA Dyslexia-friendly Style Guide 2023 list, the RNIB Clear Print fallback (12 pt min, ideally 14 pt), the Jersey + NIDirect-approved fallback, and renders all Welsh / Manx (no diacritics) / Irish séimhiú (ṡ ḟ ḃ ḋ ġ ṗ ṫ ċ ṁ) / Jèrriais / French accented characters.

scale.caption: 14 px / 400 weight
scale.h4: 18 px / 600 weight (matches JCQ 18 pt modified-paper floor)
